I have been wondering about docs#Lean.Parser.Tactic.as_aux_lemma , in particular if/when should it be used directly and should it be used more often in #mathlib4 or at all?

Currently it seems to only appear directly in a few places in files up the import chain. It barely seems to appear in core either, some in tests.

Is it meant to be an implementation detail/removed from explicit use if not meta programming?

Is it used in grind for all its named proof stuff I sometimes see as terms?

If the proof generated by a tactic is very large, and this proof appears inside a goal at some point, then it can be helpful for performance to use as_aux_lemma. However, lots of tactics, like grind, already wrap their proof in an aux lemma, so then there is no need to do this yourself. So, there just aren't that many places where it is useful.
